title: Senior Annuitant Ceilings on the Surrender Charge Percentage — Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
**Applies to:** full surrender of an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract.

The schedule-year surrender percentage is capped at **2% (0.02)** where the annuitant is aged **75** or more on the handling date, capped at **3% (0.03)** where the annuitant is aged **70** or more but under 75 on the handling date, and left uncapped where the annuitant is under 70. A cap is a ceiling — the capped surrender percentage is the lower of the schedule-year surrender percentage and the cap — so it never raises the percentage.

**Worked through (hypothetical schedule-year percentages):**

| Annuitant's age on the handling date | Ceiling | 8% becomes | 3% becomes | 2% becomes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 75 or more | 2% | 2% | 2% | 2% |
| 70 to 74 | 3% | 3% | 3% | 2% |
| Under 70 | None | 8% | 3% | 2% |

**Boundaries:** aged 74 on the handling date — 3% ceiling, aged 75 — 2% ceiling; aged 69 — no ceiling, aged 70 — 3% ceiling. The age is taken on the handling date, in whole years last birthday from the annuitant's date of birth; a birthday falling after the handling date does not count.
